mapper.update: UPDATE int_execution_stage s INNER JOIN int_execution e ON e.execution_id = s.execution_id SET s.stage_status = 'FAILED', s.error_code = CASE WHEN LEFT(e.stage, 10) = 'REFERENCE_' THEN 'PROCESS_INTERRUPTED' WHEN e.stage IN ('U8_REQUEST_SENDING', 'U8_REQUEST_SENT', 'U8_CONFIRMED', 'OA_WRITTEN_BACK', 'START_OA_PROCESS', 'CANCEL_OLD', 'COMPLETED') THEN #{afterSendCode} ELSE #{beforeSendCode} END, s.error_message = CASE WHEN LEFT(e.stage, 10) = 'REFERENCE_' THEN '进程中断，参照查询未完成，请重新发起查询' WHEN e.stage IN ('U8_REQUEST_SENDING', 'U8_REQUEST_SENT', 'U8_CONFIRMED', 'OA_WRITTEN_BACK', 'START_OA_PROCESS', 'CANCEL_OLD', 'COMPLETED') THEN '进程中断，外部处理结果未知，请先核对目标系统实际结果' ELSE '进程中断，任务未进入外部发送阶段，可由管理员重试' END, s.end_time = NOW(), s.update_time = NOW() WHERE e.status = 'RUNNING' AND e.start_time < #{staleBefore} AND s.stage_status = 'STARTED'
mapper.select: SELECT stage_log_id, execution_id, sequence_no, stage, stage_status, request_payload, response_payload, error_code, error_message, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time FROM int_execution_stage WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} ORDER BY sequence_no ASC, stage_log_id ASC
